rules.statement: The Supreme Court of Sri Lanka has the power to correct all errors in fact and/or in law committed by the Court of Appeal or any court of first instance, once an appeal is granted.
rules.supporting_quote: "Article 127 spells the appellate jurisdiction of this Court. This appellate jurisdiction extents to the correction of all errors in fact and / or in law which shall be committed by the Court of Appeal or any Court of first instance."
